headline: KKR and Mirastar Complete Acquisition of Portfolio of Four Prime UK Logistics Assets from PLP
summary: LONDON, July 31, 2026--KKR and Mirastar, KKR Real Estate’s industrial and logistics platform in Europe, have announced the acquisition of a portfolio of four prime UK logistics assets from PLP for approximately £170 million, totalling 1.25 million square feet.
